complaints.title: Formal Complaint Regarding Hazardous Footpath Condition near Misroad & Cozyden Hostel
complaints.department_name: Demo Public Works & Civic Assets Department
complaints.summary: The footpath near Misroad and Cozyden Hostel is severely deteriorated, presenting a significant risk of falls and potential vehicle accidents. The existing surface is uneven and riddled with potholes, creating a hazardous environment for pedestrians and cyclists.
complaints.complaint_body:
Subject to immediate attention.  The footpath located near Misroad and Cozyden Hostel is severely deteriorated, presenting a significant hazard to pedestrians and cyclists. The existing surface is uneven and riddled with potholes, creating a dangerous environment.  The damage is exacerbated by the presence of debris accumulation.  We request urgent inspection and repair to mitigate this risk.  Please prioritize this matter for immediate action.  We request a detailed report outlining the extent of the damage and a proposed repair plan within 48 hours.  A photographic record of the issue is attached.  Thank you for your prompt attention to this critical issue.

Aarav Sharma – +91 98765 43210 – [Citizen Email Address]

[Date]
